notes.title: Great NAISU discounts for honoring the release of Mokoko X
notes.notes:
For honoring our latest game Mokoko X's release week, we are discounting all NAISU games greatly! You can find even further discounts if you check our bundles.

Mokoko X is certainly our biggest game so far. We hope you like it!
